_comment: Business-line template: Nursery / Tissue-Culture Plant Hardening Unit (horticulture). PROCESSING revenue model with capacity_mode=annual_throughput: capacity is annual plantlet throughput (plants/yr = plants-per-cycle x hardening cycles), and 'wastage' is plant mortality during hardening. Polyhouse/shade-net are civil construction; misting/irrigation/benches are machinery. Scheme: MIDH (horticulture). Mapped to the 5-yr NIFTEM base.
report_title: DETAILED PROJECT REPORT - TISSUE-CULTURE PLANT HARDENING & NURSERY UNIT

narrative.product_intro: The unit hardens (acclimatises) tissue-culture plantlets and raises vegetable seedlings into robust, field-ready planting material. Delicate lab-grown plantlets are gradually adapted to ambient conditions in a controlled polyhouse and shade-net environment, giving farmers high-quality, disease-free saplings of crops such as banana, papaya and vegetables.
narrative.raw_material_note: The main input is tissue-culture plantlets procured from accredited TC laboratories, together with growing media (cocopeat), portrays, nutrients and plant-protection consumables. The unit is best located near horticulture clusters with assured water and power.
process_steps: Receipt and acclimatisation of tissue-culture plantlets from the lab
Primary hardening in polyhouse (high humidity, controlled temperature)
Transplanting to portrays / bags with cocopeat media
Grading, culling of weak plants and quality checks
Packing and dispatch of field-ready saplings
